answer: An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The wharf schedule is applied in terrace and oasis shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 34% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3220 identities would post 1724 proofs and burn roughly 12 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
